row:
When your doctor refers you to physical therapy, you have the right to choose where you go. ReQuest Physical Therapy offers thousands of reasons to choose us as your physical therapy provider.

We offer more than a dozen outstanding therapy programs for everything from arthritis and aquatic therapy to weight loss, cancer recovery, sports rehabilitation, and stroke recovery. 


Our compassionate staff will be there to help motivate you every step of the way throughout your rehabilitation and recovery.
We have two convenient locations:

Main Center • 4820 Newberry Road, Gainesville, FL 32607
Call 352-373-2116 • Fax 352-373-1507 

Tioga • 12830 SW First Lane, Suite 100, Newberry, FL 32669
Call 352-692-2131 • Fax 352-331-3221
